title: Davao Doctors College grad tops optometrists licensure exam
summary: A graduate of Davao Doctors College Inc. scored the highest in the computer-based licensure examination given in September and October, the Professional Regulation Commission said.

blocks.text: A graduate of Davao Doctors College Inc. scored the highest grade in the recent computer-based licensure examination, the Professional Regulation Commission said.
According to the PRC, 394 test takers out of 423 passed the exam, given by the Board of Optometry in Metro Manila in September (written) and October (practical).

Gabriell Jace Mart Legaspi Tangaran of Davao Doctor College achieved the top score of 92.11%, while the best-performing school with 50 or more test takers is Centro Escolar University-Manila, with 160 of its 169 examinees passing.

Among schools with 25 to 49 examinees, three had 100% passing rates: South western University (49 test takers), Manila Central University-Caloocan City (43) and Mindanao Medical Foundation College (30).
